items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-09-08
items.q: He was playing with St. Marvin.

ctx.x: He used to come with Flayton.
He was playing with St. Marvin. Used to come on the boat. He used to come on the boat, he had faith more.
What did he look like? Chubby?

items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-04-07
items.q: He came down here with no Faith Marvelous, with Faith Marvel.

ctx.x: When you started, did you have any feature on clarinet or pick it up yourself?

I picked it up myself. I picked it up myself. I picked it up myself. Now on drum, I picked it up myself, but there's a fellow by the name of Floyd Casey. He came down here with no Faith Marvelous, with Faith Marvel. It was him and Floyd Casey and he was a wonderful drummer too.
That's the same guy who used to work with Dewey Jackson? Might have been.
